Name: The Gardens of Athribis
Author: minathri
Description:
Abandoned, up for adoption

Currently, this mod has four new crops and three new items (four if you count the currently unused egg item that'll be used later). All should be buyable in Pierre's!

*NOTE: The current main image is taken without SpriteMaster's graphic smoothing, the rest were probably mostly taken with it. Forgot I even had it on!
